summary: AI Engineer building production LLM systems: retrieval pipelines, multi-agent orchestration, and model fine-tuning. Selected as Betopia AI Champion, ranked the top AI Engineer across all of Betopia’s business units (2026). I focus on self-hosted LLM infrastructure that runs at enterprise scale on-premises, using vLLM for GPU serving, LangGraph for agent workflows, RAG, and LoRA/QLoRA/GRPO for fine-tuning, in Python and FastAPI.

education.degree: B.Sc. in Computer Science and Engineering

publications.citation: Md. A. Rahman*, M. N. Hasan, M. S. Hossain, W. Tasnim, and S. S. Nakshi, "Enhanced Hybrid Deep Learning Approach for Heart Attack Prediction Using ECG Data," presented at the 5th IEEE International Conference on Signal Processing, Information, Communication and Systems (SPICSCON 2026), Natore, Bangladesh, Aug. 2026.

achievements: Betopia AI Champion (2026) – ranked the top AI Engineer across all Strategic Business Units of Betopia Limited in a company-wide competitive selection.
Ranked among top participants at BLP Workshop and BUBT AI Conquest competitive AI/ML events.
Solved 100+ LeetCode problems, focused on dynamic programming, graph algorithms, and system-level optimisation.
Led multiple university software projects using Agile/Scrum: sprint planning, code review, and cross-functional coordination.
